Nadia, I posted the list in a reply to your message in #strategic-pod. It has four Vantorre Group tickets, none of them Mobility's.

1. **#8841 (also written #PD-8841).** It appears in the #strategic-pod thread (7/1) and in the Moss digests of 4/27, 5/4 and 9/30.
2. **INC-4821.** It's in #inc-vtg-hartford (8/3).
3. **VT-55120.** It's the Hartford root-cause ticket, in #inc-vtg-hartford (10/14).
4. **#PD-4418.** It's in the 9/15/2025 digest, which only says "the account Nadia runs" and never names Vantorre. Please confirm it's Vantorre Group before it goes to Mateo.

Check #8841 before the steering committee. It's closed on 7/1 but open again on 9/30. The site is Allentown in the earlier entries and Newark on 9/30. It could be one ticket reopened or a reused number.

I can only see these three sources, not the ticketing system, so this isn't a complete ticket history.
